title: The Architecture of Authority Rests on Three Interlocking Doctrines
content_summary: Three interlocking rings labeled Dominion, Wisdom, and Necessity meet at a central gold hub called The Living Hinge.
text_blocks: The Architecture of Authority Rests on Three Interlocking Doctrines
The ownership of the world and the arithmetic of spirits.
The trust demanded by absolute insight.
The geometric proof of a single supreme head.
The point where abstract philosophy becomes the physical engine of sacred law.

title: Every Added Spirit Grants a New Dominion Over the World Below It
content_summary: A five-level ascending hierarchy from Earth to The Imam, each rung adding a spirit and granting dominion over the level below.
text_blocks: Every Added Spirit Grants a New Dominion Over the World Below It
Rank is not a symbol of authority. Rank is authority; the two are the same quantity read twice.

title: To Take Without Leave is the Seizure of a Shadow From the Object That Cast It
content_summary: A two-panel contrast between chaotic tangled paths labeled The Error of Usurpation and an orderly outbound-return circle labeled The Reality of Fay'.
text_blocks: To Take Without Leave is the Seizure of a Shadow From the Object That Cast It
The world does not become the imam's property when he receives it. It was always his. Receiving it only makes the ownership visible.

title: Mastery and Care Are the Same Mathematical Relationship Read From Two Sides
content_summary: A balance-scale layout pairing three powers of Dominion against three duties of Care around a central axiom.
text_blocks: Mastery and Care Are the Same Mathematical Relationship Read From Two Sides
The right to utilize and direct
The authority to act against the inclination of the governed
The higher the dominion, the heavier the duty of care that comes bound to it. To turn predator is to betray the office.
The obligation to guard and tend well-being
The duty to shield from harm
The necessity of protecting the governed from their own foolish appetites

title: Obscurity is Not Withholding, But Wisdom Routed Through a Channel the Ground Can Absorb
content_summary: A winding channel descends from The Immediate Command through layers of Time, Resistance, and Discipline down to The Intended Wisdom.
text_blocks: Obscurity is Not Withholding, But Wisdom Routed Through a Channel the Ground Can Absorb
When people cannot receive wisdom plainly, the imam embeds it in dense symbols. The believer's resistance is a fact about the length of their sight, not the emptiness of the command.

title: To Claim an Act is Empty is to Declare the Actor Wisdom-less
content_summary: Two contrasting equations — the futile act versus the wise act — with a descending flow of consequences on the left.
text_blocks: To Claim an Act is Empty is to Declare the Actor Wisdom-less
Structurally impossible for the Wise Agent.
This individual has departed from wisdom.
Exit from the domain of the Imamate.
Net Result: Absolute structural welfare (Even if obscured by time delay).
The necessary state of the Imamic decree.
Taslim is not a surrender of the mind. It is what the mind concludes once it has granted that the Wise One is wise.

title: Three Structures of Necessity Answer Three Specific Doubts of Reason
content_summary: A 3x3 table mapping The Flock, The Body, and The Ranks against the Doubter's Premise, Structural Reality, and Unavoidable Proof.
text_blocks: Three Structures of Necessity Answer Three Specific Doubts of Reason
A capable society can manage itself.
Unshepherded, they perish by predators and poor pasture.
Competence requires steering; the flock is not defective, just untended.
Leadership is a slow-acting good we can temporarily pause.
Without a head, it does not limp; it rots in a single day.
Hierarchy is merely a human invention.
The stallion, rooster, crane, and bee operate on built-in gradation.
Headship precedes human contracts; it is a biological instinct.

title: The Grammar of Supremacy Cannot Be Mapped Onto a Surpassed State
content_summary: Three essential-state terms on the left are opposed across a divider to three contrary-state terms on the right, with clashing arrows between them.
text_blocks: The Grammar of Supremacy Cannot Be Mapped Onto a Surpassed State
To call the led man the leader is not a moral mistake; it is a misuse of language, a word applied to its own contrary.

title: Pretenders Are Disqualified at the Innermost Gate of Governance
content_summary: Concentric rings of Governance (Public, Household, Self) with a Pretender's dotted path blocked by a red X at the innermost Governance of the Self.
text_blocks: Pretenders Are Disqualified at the Innermost Gate of Governance
Because they cannot command their own appetites, the outer domains remain structurally locked to them. The field is empty but for one.

title: Abstract Authority is the Physical Hinge for the Pillars of Sacred Law
content_summary: A hinge structure rising from Dominion, Wisdom, and Necessity into The Living Hinge, which branches out to the five pillars of worship.
text_blocks: Abstract Authority is the Physical Hinge for the Pillars of Sacred Law
The doctrines are not abstract theories to be set aside. They are the living hinge on which every single act of worship turns.
